name: Protein-Rich Savoury Soy Yogurt Bowl
ingredients: 1 cup plain unsweetened high-protein soy yogurt
½ cup cooked chickpeas, rinsed and drained
steps: Spoon soy yogurt into two serving bowls and whisk until creamy.
Pat chickpeas dry and season with cumin, pepper and a little salt.
Top yogurt with chickpeas, cucumber and carrot.
Add pumpkin seeds, herbs and lemon juice.
Serve immediately; keep chilled until serving.
note: Choose unsweetened soy yogurt with a higher protein content; brands vary considerably.
